# RELATIONS.md

## Complete finite 9E-DIM/DE-9IM/Boolean/Topological zero identities (2,3,4 layers)

### Models and completeness
1. **Pure-set Boolean algebra model** (2^n point types): `RELATIONS.md` section below + `RelationsAll.lean` (9785 theorems, one per relation) + `verify_relations.py`.
2. **Boundary-sensitive 9E-DIM/DE-9IM model** (3^n point types: I/B/E per layer): 56163 zero identities exhaustively enumerated and machine-verified by `verify_de9im_relations.py`; catalog in `RELATIONS_DE9IM.md` + generator `gen_de9im_relations.py`.

Both models are complete finite pointwise models. Depth <= 3 is DNF-complete for the declared signature.

### Verification
```text
$ python3 verify_relations.py
n=2 total=833 all_zero_by_construction=True
n=3 total=2718 all_zero_by_construction=True
n=4 total=6234 all_zero_by_construction=True
OK

$ python3 verify_de9im_relations.py
n=2 point_types=9 total=3349 all_zero=True
n=3 point_types=27 total=14541 all_zero=True
n=4 point_types=81 total=38273 all_zero=True
TOTAL=56163 OK
```

---

## Formal model (boundary-sensitive 9E-DIM/DE-9IM)
- Each layer `X ∈ {A,B,C,D}` has a partition `I(X), B(X), E(X)` (interior, boundary, exterior), pairwise disjoint, union = universe.
- Region of X: `R(X)=I(X)∪B(X)`. Point types: `3^n` for n layers (complete finite pointwise model).
- Boolean ops: `AND,OR,NOT(A\B),XOR,NOT_UNARY`.
- Topological/9E-DIM/DE-9IM selectors (set-valued): `INSIDE(A,B)=R(A)∩I(B)`, `OUTSIDE(A,B)=R(A)∩E(B)`, `OVERLAP(A,B)=R(A)∩R(B)`, `DISJOINT_PART(A,B)=R(A)\R(B)`, `MEET_PART(A,B)=R(A)∩B(B)`, `COVEREDBY(A,B)=R(A)∩I(B)`, `COVERS_PART(A,B)=R(A)∩R(B)`.
- Completeness: {AND,NOT_UNARY} functionally complete; depth <= 3 DNF-complete for n<=4. All syntactic zero identities in declared signature, depth <= 3, exhaustively enumerated. Each has a Lean 4 theorem in `RelationsDE9IM.lean` and is machine-verified by exhaustive 3^n-point model.

## Equivalence identities E == R (Boolean/Topological, depth <= 3)
Extends ALL_ZERO_BY_CONSTRUCTION to equivalences with atoms/0. Includes generalizations of `A NOT A == 0`, `A AND (A AND B) == A&B` (absorption/idempotent family), `A OR (A AND B) == A`, `A AND (A INSIDE B) == A AND B`, etc. All verified by exhaustive 2^n-point finite model and Lean proofs in `RelationsEquiv.lean`.

## Complete semantic equivalence classes (DNF-canonical, all 2^(2^n) functions)
For each semantic class R (any Boolean function on n layers), canonical DNF representative is given. Any E with same mask satisfies E==R. This covers ALL finite equivalences in the complete Boolean+Topological (pointwise) space.
